title: Model package reference statistics
description: Per-feature distribution summary of the training data, used as the drift baseline. This exists because a model trained outside production has no in-database dataset for production to compare against; without it, drift for an externally-trained model could not be computed at all.

row_count.description: Rows the summary was computed from. Surfaced next to any drift verdict so a comparison against a small baseline is not read as confidently as one against a large baseline.

features.description: Keyed by feature name; each entry must match the feature's declared type in the manifest.

quantiles.description: Optional; keyed by quantile as a decimal string, e.g. "0.5".

frequencies.description: Observed level to its share of rows, each between 0 and 1.
